text:
Maya: Quick sprint - prepping a two-day social push for the May benchmark webinar. Need X thread, LI carousel, plug for recording, and clear inbound routing. Who can take what?

Connor: Ill draft the X thread and a pinned recording tweet. Short, punchy. Will post hooks for A/B.

Priya: Ill own LinkedIn carousel copy + 3 variants (benchmark, ops, product). Need stat callouts and a methodology link.

Ben: Ads: Ill set up sponsored sets. Budget ask $2k; target eng roles and 50+ companies. Will retarget site visitors.

Zoe: Ill handle influencer seeding (6 dev advocates). Outreach template ready. Offer slide access + recording early.

Liam: Ill build the HubSpot form and routing. Fields: name, company, job_title, company_size, utm. Form name: webinar_bench_may_2026.

Maya: Core CTAs: 1) Register (short form) 2) Watch recording 3) Book 1:1 (top leads). Primary UTM: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=bench_may.

Connor: X thread outline: Tweet1 hook stat, Tweet2 stat card, Tweet3 micro-case, Tweet4 CTA + shortlink. Ill include 2 hook variants (cost vs latency).

Priya: Carousel frames: problem, approach, stat, methodology CTA. Will tag design for frames 1080x1080.

Ben: Targeting snippet for ads:
geo: [US, UK, DE, FR]
titles_include: ["SRE","ML Engineer","Platform Engineer"]
company_size: [50-5000]
retarget_days: 7

Zoe: Seed message (short): "Hey <name> - hosting a benchmarks webinar on latency + cost wins. Would love if you could share. Well send slides + early access. Thx  Zoe"

Liam: Routing rules (pseudo):
if job_title matches (SRE|ML|Platform|Infra) or company_size >=200:
  score +=40
if utm_source in (x, linkedin):
  score +=10
if attended_live:
  score +=50
if score >=80:
  owner = SDRs_high
elif score >=50:
  owner = SDRs_warm
else:
  owner = nurture_seq

Maya: Legal check: use "internal benchmark" qualifier on stat cards. Note on carousel final card link to methodology.

Priya: Will add the qualifier and methodology link.

Connor: Assets from design: stat card (1200x675), hero (1200x628), 15s GIF clip, speaker headshots.

Ben: Ads plan: start sponsored 48h before, boost recording post-event for 72h. Monitor CTR -> reg conversion hourly in last 24h.

Zoe: Ill drop the seed list in DM and track replies. Will note any declines.

Liam: Top leads workflow: saved list name webinar_top50_bench_may_2026. SDR outreach within 24h for top 50; top 200 get segmented email + recording.

Maya: Timing: X at 09:00 PT, LinkedIn at 09:30 PT, webinar 11:00 PT. Dry run 24h prior to capture clips.

Connor: A/B: Variant A benchmark-first, Variant B feature-first. Measure CTR->reg conversion.

Priya: Design ask in #design-handoff by EOD today.

Ben: Campaign drafts created. IDs LI-9501, X-9022. Will publish after copy approval.

Remind Bot: Reminder set - "Upload carousel frames" for today 17:00 PT in #marketing.

Maya: Final owners: Connor X + thread, Priya LI + carousel, Zoe seeds & influencer outreach, Liam HubSpot + routing, Ben ads, Maya approvals. Drop :+1: if good or flag blockers.

Ads Bot: Shortlinks generated: rwd.in/bench-may (primary), rwd.in/bench (backup).
